purpose: Record the bounded local deep-runtime proof gate for import, export, bulk, retention, legal-hold, rollback, parser-safety, and provider-transfer posture without making environment, live-provider, legal, regulatory, production, or full-parity readiness claims.

controls.controlPurpose: Preserve USF-162 local hermetic import/export/bulk proof while adding USF-163 deep-runtime assertions.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: The local hermetic proof is not environment promotion or live-provider readiness.

controls.controlPurpose: Prove partial-success item outcomes, safe retry/resume job dispatch, and value-free retry evidence for synthetic imports.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No production database migration, backfill, or live resumable provider readiness is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Prove provider-source and provider-destination operation attempts fail closed unless a separately authorised transfer adapter exists.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No live transfer provider, live external transfer provider, credential, customer transfer, or external egress readiness is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Prove CSV formula injection and ZIP decompression-bomb checks fail closed in the local parser safety helper while broader parser adapters remain bounded.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No complete CSV, JSONL, XLSX, ZIP parser adapter suite or production parser operation is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Prove destructive operations require rollback or compensation posture and can dispatch a synthetic rollback job with value-free audit evidence.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No production data rollback, customer recovery, or migration rollback readiness is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Prove high-risk requester self-approval is denied and separate synthetic approver approval is required before execution.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No production approval workflow, separate approval operation, access review, or break-glass operation is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Prove purge execution is privileged and audited when the purge window is open, and that value-free purge evidence is emitted.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No production retention scheduler, DSR fulfilment, legal retention service, or custom retention readiness is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Prove legal hold blocks purge in the local evidence package workflow.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No legal export, eDiscovery, regulatory export, litigation hold, or production legal workflow readiness is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Record that broad HTTP/OpenAPI bulk route surfaces are reclassified outside this source issue except for local proof boundaries.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No public bulk API, external developer API, generated client, gateway-live, or environment readiness is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Record legal, eDiscovery, and regulatory export as non-equivalent to the bounded local evidence package and legal-hold proof.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No legal export readiness, eDiscovery readiness, regulatory export readiness, certification, or production operation is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Record production migration as outside the authorised local synthetic proof boundary.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: No production migration, production data backfill, production rollback, or customer-data migration readiness is claimed.

controls.controlPurpose: Link import/export/bulk proof to API, files, jobs, guardrails, audit, observability, provider, retention, and privacy boundaries without upgrading those domains.
controls.nonClaimBoundary: Cross-domain linkage does not close USF-133 or imply source issue completion outside USF-163.
